newsitem.title: INDIA: Good demand at Calcutta tea auction Calcutta tea.
newsitem.headline: Good demand at Calcutta tea auction Calcutta tea.

text.p: The Calcutta tea auction saw a good demand for all varieties of tea this week, traders said on Friday.
In all 62,770 packages, including 5,576 packages of Darjeeling tea, were on offer.
In CTC category Dooars and cleaner Assams quoted higher by two rupees/kg. Major blenders gave strong support and there was improved inquiry from CIS countries, traders said.
In Orthodox variety, all brokens and fannings were dearer. Traders said there was good support from the Gulf and CIS countries.
